notes.content:
[h3]Hello Players! 🐾
[/h3]
We’ve just released a fresh update for Animal Shelter 2, focused mainly on improvements and fixes for the co-op mode.

We know that some of you have been struggling with issues like disconnects and the dreaded blackscreen. Over the past weeks our team has been working hard to reproduce these problems on our side so we could finally track them down and deal with the root cause.

This patch should help smooth things out and (hopefully!) let you enjoy your time in the shelter with friends without those annoying interruptions.

[u][b]Patch notes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed a lot of errors that caused disconnects or made connection attempts fail
[*] Improved how connection errors are handled in the main menu
[*] Properly handled connection errors when failing during game transition
[*] Disconnect window now includes a button that lets you easily send us log files
[/list]

[b]If you still experience blackscreen issues or connection problems in co-op after this update, please let us know — your reports really help us track down what’s going on. 💌[/b]

We truly hope this update fixes the issues you’ve been experiencing and makes co-op a more stable and fun experience. Thanks a lot for your patience and support 💙


See you soon,
Animal Shelter 2 Team

Every update brings us closer to making your shelters the best they can be!
We can’t wait to hear your thoughts, so keep the feedback coming, you’re helping us make [b]Animal Shelter 2[/b] even better!

notes.content:
[h2]Hello again Animal Lovers! 🐾[/h2]

[h3]Big news – UPDATE II has arrived! 🎉
This is the second major step on our roadmap, and we’re beyond excited to deliver more improvements, fixes, and features that bring your shelters to life in new ways.[/h3]

Your passion, feedback, and creativity keep inspiring us to push Animal Shelter 2 further – and with every update, the world of your furry friends gets better, smoother, and more fun to manage. 💖
So what’s waiting for you this time? Let’s take a look! 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/442f1e477aee2bf525d2f8e168db0356bf1ef0ce.png[/img]

[u][b]Additions and Changes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] We heard you! Pets adopted by you no longer count towards pet limits.
[*] Take more pets on a leash at the same time! Starting today, a new leash is available in the shop that will allow you to take a walk with up to 3 pets at the same time!
[*] Taking all items from a delivery box (or any other future container) now uses also character's inventory, not only their item's hotbar.
[*] Sell your unneeded stuff! Bought chair that you don't like any more? When putting it in the trash it will be recycled instead and you will get back at some of the money you've spend.
[*] Photo camera now has zoom features and artistic filters.
[*] New shortcut to quickly take out the camera (default key is "V" for keyboard).
[*] The reputation limit has been lifted! You can get much, much, more max reputation. Also reputation stars in tablet will change colors depending on amount of reputation, e.g low reputation - bronze stars, higher reputation - silver stars.
[*] We've also added tips for most common questions to the loading screen (and even more tips are incoming!)
[*] 
[/list]

[u][b]More changes, fixes and additions:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] For more convenience you can now set preferred temperature units also in the game settings.
[*] Never miss new encyclopedia entry: a small dot will appear on the encyclopedia button to indicate a new entry has been added.
[*] Improvements for placing items.
[*] Unlocked encyclopedia entries now appear on top, so they're easier to notice.
[*] Current temperature will now be shown in tablet weather widget.
[*] Popups won't be displayed while photo mode is active.
[*] Fixed outside cage doors in level 2 cages being closed with 'close inside cage doors' setting enabled.
[*] Fixed going back to main menu after host closing server.
[*] Added suffix "CLIENT" to user report summary when send by client.
[*] Added a setting that allows to specify whether item should be dropped when no suitable place is found.
[/list]


We can’t wait to hear what you think of these updates – every piece of feedback makes a difference, and it helps us shape the shelter exactly the way you want it. 🐶🐱


[h3]And don’t forget.. This is just the second step of our roadmap… many more updates are still ahead! 🚀[/h3]

notes.title: ROADMAP - First Milestone Ready ✅
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Animal Lovers! 🐶🐱[/h2]

[h3]We’ve got some exciting news to share with you today – UPDATE I  is here! 🎉
This is the very first big step on our roadmap, and we couldn’t be happier to bring you a set of improvements, fixes, and new settings that make managing your shelter smoother and more enjoyable.[/h3]

Everything we add and adjust is shaped by your feedback – and we love seeing how passionate you are about making life better for your four-legged friends. 🐾

So let’s get straight to it – here’s what’s new and improved in this update: 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/696457088230fec2be2702d11415e74634aecb58.png[/img]

[u][b]Additions and Changes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Added a setting that allows to change pets' fur intensity.
[*] Added a setting that allows to change pets' aging speed or turn it off completely.
[*] Added a setting that allows to change disease spreading speed, or even turn it off completely!
[*] Added a setting that allows to separately change auto closing of doors in cages, one setting for outside doors and doors inside the building.
[*] Added a setting that allows workers to close already opened doors in cages, separated to inside and outside doors setting.
[*] Added buttons in shelter management that allow to turn on/off all heating/cooling items at once.
[*] Added greater range of values for mouse sensitivity setting, from [min 0.02, max 1.25] -> [min 0.002, max 1.5] to allow greater available range.
[*] Added a setting that allows to change grid toggling method from holding button to toggle on/off.
[*] Added a setting that allows to change sprint toggling method from holding button to toggle on/off.
[*] Added a setting that allows to hide quest panel.
[*] After first shelter upgrade the grass will be shorter and better maintained so that balls and other small objects do not get lost in it.
[*] Lowered delivery drone sound intensity a bit.
[/list]

[u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue when clients sometimes were having incorrectly upgraded shelter after joining server mid game.
[*] Fixed host sometimes having incorrectly upgraded shelter after loading a save file.
[*] Implemented zoom in/out on the shelter map using gamepads.
[*] Implemented correct tooltips for zooming in/out for gamepads.
[*] Fixed workers having different outfit each day.
[*] Changed default graphics settings for SteamDeck.
[*] Corrected font size to be easily visible on SteamDeck.
[*] Fixed an issue where some animals would change to incorrect colors after growing up.
[*] Sphinx no longer changes color when at a distance.
[/list]

We hope these changes make your shelter feel even more alive and enjoyable. 🌟
Thank you for supporting Animal Shelter 2 your feedback truly helps us make the game better with every update.

[h3]Stay tuned, because this is just the beginning – more updates are on the way! 🚀🐾[/h3]

notes.title: ISSUES WITH CO-OP MODE 🌐 — and how you can fix or avoid them
notes.content:
[h3][b]Dear Friends! 🐾[/b][/h3]

[h3]Thank you for such a warm welcome to our game Animal Shelter 2, your engagement truly means a lot to us 💛[/h3]

Since the game's release, we have already made the first updates to improve your gameplay 🛠️,[b] but we also see that some of you are reporting issues with our CO-OP mode in the game[/b].

In our game, we use solutions provided by Steam, which means that every player who opens the game session becomes the Host and uses their own internet connection.

[h3]In practice, this means that the quality of the Host’s internet connection will determine the quality of the game for all players in that session 🌐[/h3]

[u][b]What does this mean in practice?[/b][/u]

You can check your internet, for example, by using the analysis tool available at speedtest.net. The result will look like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/6bc569e7e020f41a56f78c7cd2263f572e02ac0d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] If the Ping (also known as latency) is [b]100[/b] or lower, it’s fine ✅
[*] But if the Ping is [b]200 or higher[/b], symptoms of desynchronization with other players may appear - as you’ve reported (issues with delays, opening doors, inability to perform actions in the game).
[*] With a Ping [b]over 300[/b], gameplay can become very difficult ❌
[/list]

[h3][b]
You also need to remember that your distance from other players matters too![/b][/h3]
If the Atlantic Ocean separates you from the game Host, the game may be [b]less enjoyable than the Ping alone would suggest 🌍
[/b]

We are currently working on fixes to the game that will make it easier for you to identify when something is wrong with the internet connection. 🔧

Thank you for being with us! 💛
We really appreciate your support  and we’re working hard to make the game better for you every day! 🐶🐱


Warm hugs,
Animal Shelter 2 Team

notes.title: 🌦️ Seasons Are Coming to Animal Shelter 2! ❄️☀️🍂
notes.content:
[h1]Hello dear Animal Shelter Community! 👋[/h1]
In our recent devlog, we dropped a few little “breadcrumbs” 🐾 hinting at a big new feature… and it’s time to officially reveal it! [b]Animal Shelter 2[/b] will feature a full [b]season and weather system[/b]! 🌍 We’re excited to share with you the details so without further ado let’s break down what that means for you and your animals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/c888cf964f0c84e08a815a7cec344657b6f911f5.png[/img]
[h3]🌙 Day & Night Temperature Changes[/h3]
Temperature isn’t static — it [b]changes throughout the day[/b]. At night it gets colder, and if animals are left [b]outside their enclosures overnight[/b], they’re [b]more likely to get sick[/b] making it even more important to take good care of all the cuties in your shelter.

[h3]🌡️ Temperature Matters[/h3]
We’re introducing a full [b]temperature mechanic[/b] that affects:
[list]-[b]Outdoors[/b] — animals left outside in cold weather may get sick! 🤧
-[b]Indoors[/b] — temperature per room depends on:
[list]-Outside conditions
-Whether heating or cooling device is turned on
-If doors are left open 🚪[/list][/list]
You’ll be able to place [b]heaters and fans[/b] to regulate room temperature! 🐕 Each animal has its [b]own optimal temperature range[/b], and keeping them comfortable is part of your job. [b]The temperature impacts the animals in more ways. It impacts their physiological needs as well as the level of their activity and behaviour❗[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/911e3abafb562999f0faa5c273d51ba7b12511a5.png[/img]
[h3]🍃 4 Seasons, Real Impact[/h3]
Animal Shelter 2 includes [b]all four seasons[/b]: spring, summer, autumn, and winter — and they’re not just visual! Each season brings its own [b]mechanics, effects, and events[/b] that will affect your daily shelter life. 🌦️

[h3]🧥 NPCs Dress for the Weather[/h3]
Both visitors and employees will [b]change clothes based on the season[/b]! ☀️❄️ Expect summer wear in the heat and winter coats in the snow. And that’s not all!! [b]You can customize your employees’ uniforms[/b] to match your style! 🎨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/7739300929d0f8480c6443156fd5b06c93bfdbe0.png[/img]
[h3]☀️ Summer vs Winter Care ❄️[/h3]
Every season comes with its own set of advantages and disadvantages and you’ll have to be thoughtful and prepared to embrace everything each season has to offer. Here are a few things to keep in mind: 😉
[list]-In [b]summer[/b], be careful not to let animals [b]overheat[/b]
-In [b]winter[/b], prevent them from [b]freezing or catching a cold[/b]
-After [b]snowfall[/b], pets can get covered in snow — dry them off when they come inside or else they may get sick![/list]
[h3]🍂 Autumn & Dirt, ❄️ Snow & Fun[/h3]
[list]-During [b]autumn[/b], wet conditions mean animals [b]get dirty faster[/b] outside
-In [b]winter[/b], snow can [b]stick to their fur[/b] and then melt indoors[/list]
[b]You can even throw snowballs at other players for fun! ⛄[/b]

[h3]📺 Weather Forecast & Effects[/h3]
Don’t worry! Although there are many things to keep in mind, we're coming with an extremely useful tool at your disposal. Weather forecasts will keep you notified about any temperature or weather change so you’re never caught unprepared!

[b]Weather forecast system[/b] shows upcoming weather like rain or snow 🌧️❄️ which can further vary in [b]intensity[/b], including:
[list]-[b]Thunderstorms, lightning, puddles[/b] ⚡🌧️
-[b]Heavy snowfall[/b] that needs to be [b]shoveled away[/b] ❄️🧹[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/78b775cbb264831627adf76d23192ffb495bde7b.png[/img]
[h3]📉 Power Outages and Seasonal Interventions 🧹[/h3]
Storms can damage the [b]fuse box[/b] — if it breaks, you’ll need to repair it or part of the shelter will [b]lose power and lighting[/b]! 💡 

Another downside of a storm is that you might find [b]fallen branches[/b] to clean up 🌳.

New seasonal activities include:
[list]-[b]Raking leaves[/b] in autumn 🍁
-[b]Shoveling snow[/b] in winter ❄️
-Helping with other [b]clean-up efforts after weather events[/b][/list]
[h3]🦆 Changing Wildlife & Fauna[/h3]
The natural world also responds to the seasons and we’ve heard about some changes in the local fauna! 🤩
[list]-Animals like [b]frogs and snails[/b] start appearing when the temperature raises 🐌
-In [b]spring[/b], [b]migrating birds fly overhead[/b] 🕊️[/list]
[h3]🛒 Seasonal Decorations & Items[/h3]
Special [b]season-themed decorations and items[/b] will be available in the shop — but only during their respective seasons so make sure to visit the shop from time to time and stock on your favorite decorations to help set the mood in your shelter! 🎃🎄🌸

[h3]🎨 Seasonal Main Menu[/h3]
Here’s a sweet detail: the [b]main menu reflects the last season you played in[/b]! It’s a small touch — but we hope it keeps you immersed in the shelter’s world 🌍💛

That’s it for now! We can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the new mechanic and all the changes it introduces. We’d also like to congratulate all of you who managed to guess the topic of today's devlog! We’ll be back soon with another one but until then — dress warm, stay cool, and keep the animals happy! 🐾💙

notes.title: Customization in Animal Shelter 2 🐾🎮
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Animal Shelter 2 fans! 👋[/h1]

Today we want to talk about one of our favorite features we're introducing to the game – [b]customization[/b]. We want to give you full freedom to create your dream shelter and personalize your character and the entire environment. So, what exactly will you be able to change in the game? Here are the details! 👇🔥

[h3]1. The Shelter and Its Appearance 🏠[/h3]
One of the most important elements of the game is, of course, the shelter – the place that will become your home and the space for many furry friends. In Animal Shelter 2, we’re giving you full control over the shelter’s look. Players will be able to change:
[list]-[b]Walls, floors, ceiling, and roof[/b] – you'll have a variety of colors and textures to choose from, allowing you to give every room a unique feel. Whether you prefer modern minimalism or a rustic atmosphere, the choice is yours! 🎨

-[b]Furniture and decorations[/b] – swap out furniture, add accessories, and decorate your shelter with stylish standing and hanging pieces! Every detail can be planned and customized to fit your style. 🪑✨[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/81864cc07c5cc7e617007ee862e79a446064c7d8.png[/img]

[h3]2. Cages and Animal Spaces 🐶🐱[/h3]
It’s not just about making the shelter look beautiful – it’s also about creating comfortable spaces for your furry companions. Animal Shelter 2 will let you [b]paint the cages[/b] – both inside and outside! You’ll have the freedom to customize the look of the cages to match your aesthetic. Whether you want bright colors or calming tones, it’s all up to you. 🎨🐾

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/7e4a7beb1cfa1d3303bd7b801a4cd21b208a4766.png[/img]

[h3]3. The Player Character 👤✨[/h3]
We want you to feel at home in the game, so we’re giving you complete control over your [b]player character's appearance[/b]. You’ll be able to customize:
[list]-[b]Gender, skin color, hair color, and eye color[/b] – plus the overall body appearance to make your character truly unique. 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♀️

[b]Outfit and hairstyle[/b] – let’s not forget about the stylish hairstyle! You’ll be able to pick your clothing, from comfortable workwear to more fashionable options for your breaks. 💇‍♀️👚[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/dbdde030010469337f186253714e85b87bc32cdf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/158d6e788d731e75a5245b922f40a6ac70805e0e.png[/img]

You can change your character’s look both at the beginning of the game and later during gameplay, in the game’s menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/d5487f8eacec6da18d3675ec46c3ce3e12bf90de.png[/img]

There’s even more as unlockable customization features for your character will be available as you progress with your gameplay and complete achievements. [b]What do you think should be available for the most challenging ones? Make sure to let us know in the comments! 💪[/b]

[h3]4. Shelter Workers and Volunteers 🧑‍🏫💪[/h3]
In Animal Shelter 2, we didn’t forget about the workers and volunteers who help in the daily running of the shelter. Each of them will have their own uniforms, and you can change their outfits depending on… the weather! ☀️❄️
Of course, the color schemes of their uniforms will also be fully customizable. This way, you can ensure that the entire game feels cohesive and 100% YOURS! 🎨🧑‍🤝‍🧑

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/5daa5dd0c2c2d5f07692a8a658fac6ec064441dc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/d395600e6ced9db766790769ee546236ca20f548.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/28c1ac08eedd8ea8f1192b3a709831b33ae230d6.png[/img]

[h3]Summary 📝[/h3]
In Animal Shelter 2, we’re all about freedom and personalization because we know how important it is to feel like the game is yours. From the shelter’s appearance to the cages, the player character, and the staff – everything can be changed to fit your preferences. We want you to feel like part of our project, and we want every change you make in the game to reflect your decisions and tastes.

We hope these customization features will draw you even deeper into the world of Animal Shelter 2 and make your shelters showcase your caring personalities and become another tool to make them feel like home for all the animals. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and see how YOUR shelters will look! 🐾✨

Thank you for reading till the end. If you’ve read carefully you might’ve spotted a feature we’ve not mentioned ever before but will be the topic of the upcoming devlog. We wonder how many of you can guess what this feature is! 😼

notes.title: Sending animals to and from the shelter
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, Animal Shelter community! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]It’s time for another Animal Shelter 2 devlog and today we're thrilled to talk about some exciting upgrades on how animals move to and from the shelter in Animal Shelter 2. 

Compared to Animal Shelter 1, where these interactions were more limited, we've significantly expanded the ways animals can find new homes, receive care, and interact with volunteers. Let's dive into the details![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/cef363878e58d9fea9cc430fb3e43c625d615538.png[/img]
[h3][b]Animal Shelter 1 🔍[/b][/h3]
In the original Animal Shelter 1, the options for handling animals outside of the shelter were fairly simple:

-Sending a car to pick up an animal.

-Sending a car to deliver an animal to its new home.

-Later, the addition of a park where players could take animals for walks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/009dd347eef74d6349b8fba6fdb1afa3cc698016.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Features in Animal Shelter 2 📝[/b][/h3]
We've taken everything from Animal Shelter 1 and greatly expanded the system in Animal Shelter 2. Now, players have more control and variety over how animals enter and leave the shelter:

-Animals still arrive via car, but now players can choose the pickup location from a map!

-Emergency rescues: Players can respond to intervention cases, rescuing animals directly.

-Adopters now visit the shelter in person instead of just receiving an animal by car.

-Medical care outside the shelter: Animals can be sent for medical examinations and treatments by selecting locations on the map.

-Pet returns: If an adoption was a poor match, there’s a chance the animal might be returned based on compatibility percentages.

-In Animal Shelter 2 there are additional people joining the stage- [b]Volunteers[/b]! They can:

notes.title: What has changed? AS1 vs AS2 Prologue
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello Animal Lovers! 👋[/b][/h2]

We're thrilled to announce that Animal Shelter 2 Prologue is just around the corner with a release date set for [b]September 13th! 🎉[/b] 

To get you ready for the big day, we’ve put together a list of exciting new features and improvements that set it apart from the original *Animal Shelter*. We can’t wait for you to dive into the game and experience all the amazing changes! 🐾


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/d4d2127e7412dae1a1869b5ba590c176132dfb11.png[/img]


[b]🌟 All-new graphics[/b]
The visuals have been significantly upgraded, especially for the animals, who now look more realistic and adorable than ever before!

[b]🏠 Enhanced shelter customization[/b]
While you can no longer move buildings, you now have much more control over customizing your existing shelter. Change walls, ceilings, floors, and even expand some rooms to suit your needs!

[b]👥 Other characters[/b]
Meet NPC workers  and adopters  who visit your shelter. This brings a new layer of interaction and managing people around you.

[b]🤝 CO-OP mode[/b]
Yes, you heard that right! Animal Shelter 2 Prologue introduces multiplayer co-op mode, so you can run the shelter with your friends or alone!

[b]🚑 External services[/b]
Need a special treatment for an animal? Now you can send them outside the shelter for surgeries or treatments, adding more depth to the care management system.

[b]🗺️ 2D world map[/b]
Explore the world outside the shelter! Use the new 2D map to discover events, activities, and interventions waiting for you and your animals.

[b]🚓 Intervention missions[/b]
Now you can personally go on rescue missions, entering different locations to help animals in need. These locations are partially procedurally generated, so each visit offers a new experience.

[b]🐶 Puppies and kittens included[/b]
No more waiting for DLC! Puppies and kittens are available from the start in [b]Animal Shelter 2 Prologue[/b], ready to melt your heart.

[b]🐕 Your own pet[/b]
You can now have a personal pet that follows you around the shelter, keeping you company as you manage your daily tasks.

[b]📝 More advanced mission system[/b]
In Animal Shelter 2 Prologue, the missions are more complex and varied.

[b]🧠 Improved animal AI[/b]
Animals in the game are now more realistic. They have their own behaviors, needs, and desires. They interact with other animals and might show unwanted behaviors that you'll need to correct, making animal care more demanding.

[b]🩺 More involved animal care[/b]
Caring for animals in Animal Shelter 2 Prologue goes beyond just physical needs. You’ll also need to manage mental and behavioral issues before the animals are ready for adoption. Every pet requires a unique approach, adding depth to the gameplay.

[b]🌗 Day and night cycle[/b]
The game now features a dynamic day and night system, which not only changes the aesthetics of the shelter but also affects daily tasks. 

[b]📱 Tablet replaces the camera[/b]
You no longer need a separate camera to take photos. All images and documents are now managed through a tablet, which serves as your "command center" in the shelter, simplifying the management process.

[b]💉 Expanded healing system[/b]
The healing system is now more detailed. Some animals will require long-term treatments, while others might need specialized care outside the shelter. You may also encounter animals with chronic health issues that require ongoing management while they stay in your care.

[b]👵 Older animals[/b]
The game now includes older animals, which have their own unique traits. They may tire faster, require more care, and can be harder to adopt out. These elderly pets add a new level of challenge to shelter management.

[b]👗 Animals can wear clothes and decorations[/b]
You can now dress your animals in clothes and decorations not only during photoshoots but anytime. This adds a personal touch to the shelter, making it even more unique and heartwarming.

[b]🐾 DLC features from the original game are now included in the base game[/b]
Features such as walking animals on leashes, using the tablet for management, and animals running freely around the shelter are now part of the base game. You can also place animals anywhere in the shelter, not just in designated spots as in the first game.

[b]🧹 Better shelter cleaning system[/b]
The cleaning system has been improved.

[b]🎁 More perks and new features[/b]
The game introduces other smaller yet important improvements like the auto-disappearance of empty delivery boxes, new gameplay-impacting perks, and overall adoption system improvements.

[previewyoutube=u1Azx7_YBlE;full][/previewyoutube]

---

We’re incredibly excited for you to experience all these new features in [b]Animal Shelter 2 Prologue[/b] when it launches [b]on September 13th[/b]! 🐾 Add the game to your wishlist now and [b]join us on Discord for the latest updates![/b]

notes.title: Interventions
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Animal Shelter Managers! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’re back with another devlog and this time, just as promised we’ll tell you more about interventions! 🤩 It’s a new mechanic introduced in Animal Shelter 2 which you’ve been curious about so we’re even more happy to share some details with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/051b1482e85079c6d991bb31ec258d1aecd21372.jpg[/img]
There is an important difference between an animal rescued in an intervention and simply taking an animal- intervention can be canceled before the car leaves the garage and during the rescue which will result in not taking the animal in❗

As you know, animals coming to your shelter are rescued one way or another. This event, although relatively simple, will give you an opportunity to take matters into your own hands. Sometimes it’s going to be a cat stuck on a tree, other times you’ll have to saw through the bars where animals got stuck. 🌳 Don’t forget that simple gestures like some food or petting will most definitely be appreciated by the rescued animal. 😹

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/b8aa37cb73941aa8f2aac5dc19851d5e37072e25.jpg[/img]
Players will be notified via mark on the tablet map in the place where you send your car to pick up the animals. But before you’re able to go you’ll have to meet some criteria such as having all the necessary equipment to rescue the poor fellow, having an available car and empty space in your shelter. 📝

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/9d24e1a3864f21db555c2ed0657cd02cf7a74bbf.jpg[/img]
There will be three unique locations in which the interventions will be able to take place- [b]suburbs, city center, park[/b]. But the places in the locations are randomly generated which will add for a more unique experience every time you help an animal! 🐕

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/a8d72c16d16531741b7e8bdd976362aa74974488.jpg[/img]
There are some types of interventions which are available for all the locations and some assigned to particular places. Let’s take a closer look at them, shall we? 👀

[h3][b]All Locations[/b][/h3]
- taking animals down from heights
- rescuing animals from rubble
- finding lost animals

[h3][b]Park[/b][/h3]
- feeding local animals (we don’t take the animal back to the shelter, we only help them to live)

[h3][b]City Center[/b][/h3]
- freeing animals whose heads got stuck between bars

[h3][b]Suburbs[/b][/h3]
- animals attached to an objects and left without care

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/51cc07a975a8c17d0048b8098dd41437ae3beed5.jpg[/img]
We’d love to hear your opinions on this mechanic. Do you like it? Will you prefer to do interventions or take in the animals without having to save them first? 🤔 Let us know in the comments! Don’t forget to join our discord and to add the game to your wishlist to get notified about every upcoming news! 💪

notes.title: Customization and Upgrade Systems
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Animal Shelter Fans! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]As promised we’re back with another topic we’d like to introduce in more details- [b]the shelter upgrade and customization systems[/b] ⬆️Most of these features are novelties in comparison to the Animal Shelter 1, that’s why we’re even more excited to hear your opinions about these mechanics! 🤩 Make sure to let us know your thoughts in the comments![/h3]

Buuuut, before we get to the devlog, the premiere of the free Prologue for Animal Shelter 2 will take place soon! So don't miss the release date and you can add it to your Wishlist now!👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2887780/Animal_Shelter_2_Prologue/

[h3][b]Shelter levels 📝[/b][/h3]
There are five levels in total for all the rooms and the shelter, the first which is essentially a “level 0” is the neglected building you’re clearing to reach level 2- an operational shelter. An important thing to remember is that in order to be able to raise the level of your shelter, you’ll first have to raise the level of all the available rooms.

You might be wondering “Hey, can I just upgrade the rooms as I please?” Yes- you can put your effort into upgrading your rooms in any order you want but there's an additional factor- ⭐[b]shelter reputation[/b]. Once you reach a certain level of reputation you’ll meet the criteria to be able to upgrade your rooms to the next level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/ae4d9499df28a09d7dc3fcd122629712baf3bcf7.png[/img]
But what exactly changes once you raise the level of the room and shelter? There are various possibilities. Let’s start with the shelter level, shall we? [b]Each level of the shelter grants you some visual upgrades such as the looks of your shelter, adjacent terrain, lawns etc. They also grant you new decorations or alter the already existing ones. What's most exciting though is that these upgrades may also come with new features for your rooms![/b] 😍  One example is gaining additional cars in your garage. 

It’s similar in case of room upgrades. [b]While all the upgrades grant you nicer looks of the rooms, some of the upgrades increase the size of a room or unlock additional space which was previously taken, giving you more possibilities. 👍[/b]

[h3]We’ve prepared some cool graphics to show you how your shelter's looks can change if you put some effort into it![/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/eacdf756969858fdc000d6fa44122ca27be8a81b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/5ba17900e97e01e6dd9e12451bc0e69a72b0baef.png[/img]

[h3][b]Painting 🖌️[/b][/h3]
One of the features available to make your shelter fit your vision is to alter the looks of the surfaces in it. You can paint:
[list][b]1. Walls
2. Ceiling
3. Floors[/b][/list]We’d like to help those of you who don’t want to spend too much time on decorating your shelters to have nicely looking buildings. That’s why we’ve prepared some presets which will be at your disposal. ❤️‍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/68d1cc0d9f6861ed01bb28f6062189dc36537a99.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/c72ffe167c55d6084623a41b6947af8b43ec7652.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/9c0375bb7889fdfe398548fb3d40a16451056a7c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/73a59eb32a8c5cc2efcc71b4ce968341d5e76c63.png[/img]
For others who would like to put more effort into making the shelter more customized, we’ve got you covered. We’re providing you with the possibility to mix the colors and materials. We’ve also prepared more fancy materials adding textures or some shape to them! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/5fb4a33cc7ad5dcbab4e8a2c0c204acadd6b7b9f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/45fa0a0bab15c286be660395e312afdd7493d226.png[/img]

[h3][b]Furniture 🪑[/b][/h3]
We’ve introduced a reworked system of placing furniture in the first person camera. It’s similar to the one used in case of smaller items but adjusted so that it doesn’t compromise your view. 👀 (the held furniture turns into a blueprint in your hand). To allow more precision a grid also appears which optionally can be snapped to while placing the objects. This way you’ll always be able to place your furniture perfectly where you want it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/b03c1740054b0f8dc621b534bcfee6e0771ea79b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/c2781770b47bca0eee85b968be9c08e8c247f7fc.png[/img]

[h3][b]Items 📚[/b][/h3]
We’ve added all sorts of small items to allow you to make your shelter even more personal. We’re positive that the addition of books, flowers, posters and other decorations will make each of your shelters truly unique and exciting places. Keep in mind that some of the decorations are dedicated to certain areas like walls. 🙂 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/9e7bc16a28d85cf16eafce0efd307681c54aa455.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/8dd5d8e8ea0f93170c97e847801582f7bb1d2012.png[/img]

notes.title: Animal adoption process
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Animal Shelter Enjoyers! 👋[/b][/h1]

Today as we promised we’ll discuss the adoption process in more detail. 📝 In Animal Shelter 1 the adoption process was fairly simple and followed two basic criteria:

-the animal had to have it’s needs satisfied
-you should pick the person whose living conditions and preferences of the animal’s behavior and features matched those of the animal looking for new home

Each animal had approximately the same number of potential owners and your job was to pick the perfect match. 👍

[h3][b]Animal Shelter 2 went a few steps further. Making the entire adoption process more developed.[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/c1823d13106b2e93afe16d705e52306b36ecdca2.png[/img]
📷 It all begins with a [b]photo[/b], just like in Animal Shelter 1 but unlike the part 1, this time the picture matters. Cute, cool looking pictures will receive an additional bonus to the adoption announcement’s effectiveness. On top of that, in Animal Shelter 2 your animals will be able to wear cute clothes in the entire shelter, not just in the photo booth. 😻

🐶 The overall [b]status[/b] of the animal looking for adoption will keep playing a vital part in finding potential owners. A well-fed, healthy and happy animal will have an easier time finding more people interested in taking that cutie home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/d023c4de05af07a60646e6c426f5dd6ec61aa909.png[/img]
[b]Perks and features[/b]. This is the most important aspect influencing the adoption speed. Just like in real life, younger animals are more likely to find new homes than their older pals. This will become one of the main adoption challenges as animals in Animal Shelter 2 come in all spectrums of age. Will you be able to find your seniors carrying owners?

Perks on the other hand will help to make every animal truly unique, giving your pupils additional features of character. There will be all sort of perks but here are a few examples of what to expect:

[b]Joyfull[/b]- happily greets the player, this exuberant animal will often want to play

[b]Clingy[/b]- very often comes to the player and follows him around, extremely social

[b]Calm[/b]- bonds easier, this animal has easier time finding new home

Other kind of perks will emphasize the overall status of the animal. A good example of such perks would be:

[b]Elderly[/b]- This animal has some years under the belt which is evident looking at its fur. It gets tired quicker and has a harder time looking for a new home.

[b]Youngster[/b]- cute, enquiring and easily likable. Those animals will be more likely to get adopted quickly.

There will also be some perks referring to animal’s illnesses, which will make taking care of the animal harder. Essentially making them less interesting targets for adoption. 

📣 If you feel like your adoption announcement needs some help, Animal Shelter 2 provides you with additional tools aiming to increase the amount of people interested in adoption. Additional text in the announcement, extra effective range, or even advertisement in the radio are at your disposal but don’t forget that each of them will require additional funds. Another feature which impacts the announcements’ visibility are the events happening on map but this is a topic for another devlog! 

That’s it for today! We’re positive that those additional information will help you maximize your effectiveness and find the best strategies to help all your animals find loving owners. If you enjoyed this devlog please, let us know in the comments! If you’d like to hear more about any particular topic you can tell us on discord or in the discussion section! 

If you haven’t already, there is an ongoing Steam Next Fest on which you can play Animal Shelter 2 Demo! 💪 Make sure to give it a try and leave us your feedback!

[h1][b]Hello Animal Fans! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to the new devlog from our Shelter! [/b]🖥️ In Animal Shelter 2, on top of the well-known functions there will be some novelties so let’s take a look at it’s functionalities, shall we?

[h3][b]Map 🗺️[/b][/h3]
This functionality will have significant, not to say fundamental importance during your gameplay because using it will allow you to pick up animals which will end up in your shelters. 🐶[b] You’ll be able to either remotely send a car or even go personally to find the place this animal got stuck in and rescue it! 🤩[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/a182cffaa02936752bda18150fe8cb1573541ca1.gif[/img]
[h3][b]Shelter managing 👉[/b][/h3]
In the previous part, the building function was in a different game level than a tablet. Currently, we’ve implemented this system in the tablet to make developing your shelters easier. 👍 This tab will allow you to inspect the condition of each individual room (are there any trash to take out, is it decorated well, etc.). On top of that, it’ll allow you to buy/sell/move cages, manage your employees and even change the name of your shelter! 👱

Check the popularity of your shelter and earn prizes as you rise in the rankings! 🤩

notes.title: Day and night cycle
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’re thrilled to welcome you to the 2nd devlog from Animal Shelter 2! Today, we’d like to talk about another feature which was frequently mentioned and asked for and it’s the ☀️ [b]day&night[/b] 🌑 cycle. As we’ve already explained, due to the limitations of the game’s code, we weren’t able to implement this feature before but with the Animal Shelter 2 that’s not an issue anymore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/77c86f2e2c954783331797ba485d6b56d42717fe.png[/img]
[h3]Today, we’ll explain this system in more detail and give you examples of its impact on other in-game mechanics! 🔥 We’ve got a lot to talk about so let’s take a look, shall we?[/h3]

[h3][b]👱 Employees[/b][/h3]
As we’ve already announced, the game will offer you a possibility to hire workers helping you to take care of daily activities at your shelter. Their help is available only during the day because when the shift is over, they’re heading home to have some rest and prepare for the following day! 👍

[h3][b]➕ Curing Animals[/b][/h3]
A change also occurs in the process of tending to sick animals. With the introduction of day and night cycle the time animals need to get well will be slightly longer than in the Animal Shelter 1. On top of that, treatments will require giving medicine every few hours at fixed intervals, once a day etc. in order to help your animals get better. 🐶

[h3][b]🚶 Adoption[/b][/h3]
This brings us to one more significant change- even if you decide to stay at the shelter for night because of the treatment of a particular animal, before it gets well you’ll not be able to arrange any adoption meetings for this animal before it gets well.

[h3][b]🐱 Animals[/b][/h3]
Finally, the Animals. Your cute pupils will also not stay indifferent to the passage of time. Because of the fact that during the night the only personnel allowed to stay at the shelter is the owner, the animals will require to be taken care of in the morning. Fill in their food and water bowls, clean up the enclosures and give them some love and affection to shake off the lonely night. Don’t worry, the employees will also come in the morning filled with energy to help you get the place tidied up. 🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/e8ea15a9f432a314aba3e1d3271e9aee95445f3a.png[/img]
As you can see, the day&night cycle will affect many different aspects of the game. Starting with the looks of the environment, through the employees' availability to even the mood of the animals at the shelter.

Keep in mind the game is still in development and we’d love to hear your opinions and ideas on the topic of today’s devlog! 🔥 Make sure to let us know on discord 👇 and add the game to your wishlists on Steam to not miss on any upcoming info!

It’s going to be further developed but you’ll be able to use some of its features in the playtest. 😀 [b]We’ve been wondering if you’ve got any idea which new feature yet to be revealed is the introduction of minimap connected to?[/b] Let us know in the comments! 😼

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/69b4d930f83950809a6431dcbef021c7c97430cd.png[/img]
[h3][b]New, improved animal models and animations of animals and the petting system 🐈 [/b][/h3]

The animals were given much, much love and have undergone a [b]complete metamorphosis[/b] 🔥! In Animal Shelter 2 we’ve focused on perfecting the cats and dogs which were given some suggestions to alter their looks in Animal Shelter 1. 

[b]The animals are various, have fluffier fur and their physique fully differs in comparison to each other![/b] 🐕 We’re also giving some love to the animations of their behavior and interactions with both other animals and people! 😍 The [b]petting mechanic has also undergone a massive upgrade[/b] and now it should be able to satisfy even the most demanding animals (and animal fans). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/6f4846c980fbfe42936774f9a0e0da6bdd2d9be8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/2c0c22dc7bae5b62d0012b3f63d02d52db1c627b.png[/img]

[h3]
Unfortunately, that brings us to the end of today’s devlog. We can’t wait to hear your opinions about the presented topics! 💭[/h3]

 If you enjoyed reading it and would like to support us then [b]consider adding Animal Shelter 2 to your wishlists on Steam [/b]👇. 

[b]Don’t forget to join our discord community where you can meet other members of the Animal Shelter Community[/b]. 

[h3]We’d also love to remind you about the possibility to sign up for the upcoming Animal Shelter 2 Demo Playtest! If you’d like to experience the AS2 first hand, all you have to do is to visit games’ main page on Steam and sign up. It’s that simple!

[/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/yDJUSSxRFV][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/04aaee60c314cb7eba5ee7af51639e5cfb0ab764.png[/img][/url] 



See you soon,
Animal Shelter 2 Team!
